title: Libre2 patched app suddenly stopped working
symptom: Libre2 patched app as source suddenly stopped working overnight. NFC scanning still shows values, but no values are received in xDrip. Restarting collector did not help.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Possible causes mentioned include Android 9.0 Pie or Bluetooth problems, a Bluetooth stack upset, or a broken intent mechanism between LibreLink and xDrip.
fix: One user reported that reinstalling both apps (LibreLink patched and xDrip) solved the problem. Another user reported that putting a new sensor resolved the issue. A suggested troubleshooting step is to clear the Bluetooth app's memory in Android settings and rescan the sensor.
evidence_quote: Reinstalling both apps helped me to solve this problem.
